text: Commercial Supplemental Criteria ­ MCG How to access Aetna® supplemental guidelines Step 1: Visit the Aetna Supplemental Criteria MCG webpage. Step 2: • Read and accept the terms and conditions. • Enter your first and last name. Choose which category best fits your interest in the guidelines. • Choose your preferred way to receive a verification code (text, email or telephone). • Enter your verification code when you receive it. - We’ll show y ou a list of MCG guidelines for Aetna content. - Choose the guidelines you want to review in your web browser. - You won’t be able to print the guidelines. These guidelines are proprietary to MCG. Y ou can’t copy or print them. We can’t distribute them without MCG’s permission. The MCG Cite Transparency tool allows accounts and regulators to view multiple guidelines at once through a web browser.
